test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: How many seconds will a boy take to run one complete round around a square field of side 38 metres, if he runs at a speed of 6 km/h?
solution:
**Given:**

Side of square field = 38 metres

Speed = 6 km/h

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Perimeter of square field = 4 × Side

⇒ Perimeter = 4 × 38 = 152 metres

Speed in m/s = 6 × (5/18) = 5/3 m/s

Time = Distance / Speed

⇒ Time = 152 / (5/3)

⇒ Time = 91.2 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
